title: Handle invalid date input in report creation
body:
File: src/db/repos/reportRepo.ts

The report creation currently throws a 500 error when an invalid date is provided. This change will handle such cases by validating the date input and returning a 400 error with a message indicating the issue with the date instead.

title: Fix email validation to ignore trailing spaces
body:
File: src/api/errors.ts

Update the email validation logic to trim whitespace from email inputs, ensuring that email addresses with trailing spaces do not return a 'validation failed' error.

title: Add limits for report fields in API reference
body:
File: docs/API.md

The API reference currently lacks information about restrictions on report fields, specifically limits on the number of recipients, the maximum length of report names, and category limits for scheduled exports. This update will document that adding a 21st recipient results in a validation failure, report names must be 120 characters or fewer, and a maximum of 50 categories can be included.

title: Align Bengaluru team's weekly summary time with others
body:
File: src/db/migrations/003_timezone.sql

The weekly summary email should be sent at 08:00 for the Bengaluru team, aligning with the time set in their profiles. This adjustment will help ensure that the summary arrives before the Monday stand-up, allowing team members to have the necessary numbers available.
